module: Data module for genericGauges: provides the outside temperature and the system time.
notes: temperatureEnv in °C (obj:getEnvTemperature() - 273.15); time = "HH:MM" string of the computer's real local time (os.date), not the game time.

updateGFX.desc: Does nothing (the update is done by updateGaugeData).

setupGaugeData.desc: Called by genericGauges with the properties requested in displayData.customModules: no property is read; always produces temperatureEnv and time.

properties.desc: Set of requested properties (key = name, value = true).

updateGaugeData.desc: Called by genericGauges before each send: fills moduleData with the requested values.

moduleData.desc: Module data table, then sent to the HTML page.

dt.desc: Time elapsed since the last send (s).
